description: Header file defining the MinidumpGenerator class for creating minidump files on MacOS, including system info gathering, thread and memory stream writing, and support for multiple CPU architectures.

classes.name: MinidumpGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating minidump files for MacOS processes, supporting multiple CPU architectures and including system, thread, memory, and module information.

methods.name: MinidumpGenerator
methods.description: Constructor accepting crashing task and handler thread ports.

methods.name: UniqueNameInDirectory
methods.description: Generates a unique filename in the specified directory for the minidump.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes the minidump to the specified file path.

methods.name: SetExceptionInformation
methods.description: Sets exception details to include in the minidump.

methods.name: SetTaskContext
methods.description: Sets the context of the task to be dumped.

methods.name: GatherSystemInformation
methods.description: Collects system info relevant for the minidump.
